summary: This edition centers the guide on exploring, refining and reviewing product designs in Claude Design.

expectedEntries.text: Begin with Figma foundations and screens or an existing implementation library.
expectedEntries.rationale: The two input routes have distinct ownership and preparation.

expectedEntries.text: Compare directions, refine with chat, comments and direct edits, then review a connected prototype.
expectedEntries.rationale: Design decisions and people reviewing the result form the main exercise.

expectedEntries.text: Finish with a reviewed prototype and usable handoff; choose Code or Figma when the next owner needs it.
expectedEntries.rationale: Implementation and editable design have separate completion checks.

expectedEntries.text: Move package inventories and detailed engineering checks into supporting material.
expectedEntries.rationale: Readers encounter technical setup when their selected route requires it.
